title: Robust Evaluation Measures for Evaluating Social Biases in Masked Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the difference between stereotypical and anti-stereotypical sentence pairs from the StereoSet and CrowS-Pairs datasets by modeling their pseudo-log-likelihood (PLL) scores as Gaussian distributions and calculating Kullback-Leibler (KL) and Jensen-Shannon (JS) divergences.
